title.zh: 宣布每年3月9日为阿布拉省特别工作假日及学校停课日，以纪念其建省纪念日与Abrenian Kawayan节闭幕
title.en: An Act Declaring March 9 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday and No Class Day in Schools in the Province of Abra in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary and the Culmination of the Abrenian Kawayan Festival
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 9 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday and No Class Day in Schools in the Province of Abra in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary and the Culmination of the Abrenian Kawayan Festival

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10774_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: March 9 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday and no class day in schools in the Province of Abra in commemoration of its foundation anniversary and the culmination of the Abrenian Kawayan Festival.
For work performed on a special working holiday, an employee to his/her regular wage.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
